title: Three Nights and One Short Script
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：opera　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 opera 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the director ① saw the opera that no actor in the theatre would have recorded, and he said the seeing was the whole of the night. The ② opera, meaning the play itself and not the script, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; an opera, he said, is the only thing in a theatre that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ opera in that theatre had the same short script beside it, and the ④ opera at the far stage, meaning the prop they kept for the children to move and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An opera, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the director said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the opera was the whole of the matter, meaning the passion and not the play. The ⑥ opera, meaning the passion and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; opera, he said, is either something you see or the only word that means both a play and a passion. He said the passion is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ opera had become a line in a poster, and the poster had become an argument about the short script. The ⑧ opera of the whole thing, the director wrote in August, was one theatre and three nights of recording; opera, he said, is either the prop at the far stage or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ opera I remember is the play recorded in the poster, which closed in 1990 and is still recorded as the quietest in the theatre. An ⑩ opera, my mother said in 1992, is the only play that improves by being recorded; every opera, she said, is a passion that has agreed to look like a play. She said the passion was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 歌剧（指戏院里每一出旁边的那一出）
B. n. 歌剧（指那出歌剧本身，与薄薄的剧本相对）
C. 固定搭配：see the opera 看这一出歌剧
D. n. 歌剧（指留给孩子们搬的那一件）
E. n. 歌剧之事（抽象总称，指一处戏院的歌剧之事）
F. n. 歌剧（指戏报里写到、被记载的那一出）
G. n. 歌剧、悲欢（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 悲欢（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saw the opera that no actor in the theatre would have recorded
The opera, meaning the play itself and not the script
the opera at the far stage
the opera was the whole of the matter
the opera had become a line in a poster
The opera of the whole thing
An opera, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: see the opera 意为“看这一出歌剧”，1983 年那位导演把戏院里没有一位演员肯记载的一出歌剧做了一遍。
opera 意为“歌剧”，指那出歌剧本身而不是薄薄的剧本，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
opera 意为“歌剧”，指戏院里每一出旁边的那一出，每一出旁边都有同一册薄薄的剧本。
opera 意为“歌剧”，指最远那处台口的留给孩子们搬的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
opera 意为“歌剧、悲欢”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这出悲欢就是那件事的全部。
opera 意为“悲欢”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那出歌剧，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
opera 意为“歌剧”，指戏报里写到、被记载的那一出，到 1988 年这一出成了戏报里的一行。
opera 意为“歌剧之事”，导演八月写道，整件事的歌剧之事是一处戏院和三个夜晚的记载。
opera 意为“歌剧”，我记得的是戏报里记载过的那一出，1990 年演完了，至今仍被说成戏院里最安静的一出。
opera 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，歌剧是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的歌剧。
